summary: Regression test for DELETE /api/ecommerce/sales/{sid} stock-restore guard. Verified fix at server.py:1583-1591 that skips _restore_sale_items when doc.stock_restored is True. 2/2 pytests passed. Scenario A (create sale -> status Dikembalikan+restore_stock=true -> delete): stock sequence before=47 -> after_create=45 -> after_return=47 -> after_delete=47 (no double restore). Scenario B (create sale -> delete without return): stock sequence before=47 -> after_create=44 -> after_delete=47 (single restore). All created sales deleted; ecommerce sales collection ends at 0 docs; product stock returned to original values.
critical_code_review_comments: Guard added correctly, but consider also setting stock_restored=True inside delete_ecom_sale after restoring (defensive) so future reads reflect state before deletion is committed — not critical since the doc is deleted immediately.
delete_ecom_sale still calls ObjectId(sid) without try/except InvalidId — same minor issue flagged in iteration_1.
test_credentials: Admin nannsond@gmail.com/admin123 (verified; login returns 'token' key, not 'access_token').
seed_data_creation: Uses existing CONTOH-001 (stok 47). Each test creates one ecom sale and deletes it; final ecom_sales count = 0; product stok restored to 47.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Product fields are 'stok' and 'harga_jual' (not 'stock'/'price'). Ecommerce sale items require 'name' and 'harga' fields. Auth login returns {'token': ...}. Run: cd /app && REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL=... python -m pytest backend/tests/test_iter_delete_ecom_stock_guard.py -n 0 -v
rca of the issue: Original minor bug: DELETE /api/ecommerce/sales/{sid} called _restore_sale_items unconditionally; if the sale was already returned (status Dikembalikan with restore_stock=true), stock was incremented twice. Fix verified at server.py line 1588: `if not doc.get('stock_restored'): await _restore_sale_items(...)`. Test confirms stock stays at original value across return->delete sequence.
